name: Daniel Hugenroth
headline: Software engineer and security researcher
summary: I am a computer security researcher and software engineer based in Cambridge, UK. As an experienced engineer, I have delivered technically complex projects in both small start-ups and large companies. This work stretches from design and implementation of novel cryptographic protocols to delightful and performant mobile apps. My academic interests revolve around confidential compute, trusted builds, AI, applied cryptography, and mobile security.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher & Affiliated Lecturer
positions.description: My research focuses on secure and anonymous communication, security, mobile devices, applied cryptography, and privacy. Always looking for interesting problems and keen to discuss collaborations.

positions.title: Independent security consultant
positions.description: Engaged as a contracting security consultant: design and implementation of a secure messaging protocol (Android, iOS, Rust backend) based on the latest academic research; education of stake holders; preparation for large security audit by a third party; and launching as CoverDrop in June 2025.

positions.title: Engineering Fellowship (3 months program)
